description: Progress across the 13 premed prerequisites on the page, in page order: General Chemistry I and II, Organic Chemistry I and II, Biology I and II, Physics I and II, Biochemistry, Psychology, Sociology, Statistics or Calculus, English (1 year). The first 11 are the MCAT core courses. Returns counts done, in progress, and planned, percent done, and whether all core courses are done. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Premed Course Planner calculator.

statuses.description: Comma-separated status for each of the 13 prerequisites in page order, each one of not, plan, prog, done, e.g. done,done,not,not,done,done,not,not,not,done,not,not,done.

name: calculate_premed_course_planner
